title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Company Description** 
 GS IT Infrastructure is a reputed IT company based in Dubai, backed by a skilled team of professionals delivering high\-quality IT support and services. The company provides comprehensive solutions including IT infrastructure implementation and support, IT strategy and consulting, application development and maintenance, and annual maintenance contracts. It also offers security system solutions, EPABX systems, call recording, biometric attendance systems, public address systems, and VoIP services, along with key products such as Microsoft 365, firewalls, Active Directory servers, antivirus software, and virtual machines. GS IT Infrastructure is committed to timely delivery, adheres to client guidelines throughout each project, and maintains 24/7 customer support to ensure responsive service and long\-term partnerships.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Graphic Designer role based in Kochi. The Graphic Designer will create visual assets for digital and print channels, including marketing collateral, social media creatives, presentations, infographics, and branding materials aligned with company and client guidelines. The role involves collaborating with marketing, sales, and technical teams to translate complex IT concepts into clear and engaging designs, maintaining brand consistency across all touchpoints. The Graphic Designer will manage multiple design requests, prepare files for production, follow feedback and review cycles, and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality work. The position requires proactive communication, attention to detail, and the ability to work in a fast\-paced environment supporting diverse IT projects.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong proficiency in graphic design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, AI tools and other relevant design software.
* Experience creating digital assets for web, social media, email campaigns, and presentations, with a solid understanding of layout, typography, and color theory.
* Ability to design print materials such as brochures, flyers, posters, banners, and corporate stationery, including preparation of production\-ready files.
* Skills in branding and visual identity, including logo design, style guides, and consistent application of brand elements across different media.
* Basic knowledge of UI/UX principles and web design concepts is an advantage.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and interpret project requirements.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines with high attention to detail.
* Relevant academic background such as a degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related field.
* Prior experience in an IT, technology, or B2B environment is beneficial.
* A portfolio demonstrating a range of design work across digital and print media is required.

title: Staff Engineer-UI
description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a Staff Engineer who can build new features in Angular 21while also rolling up your sleeves on older code\-refactoring legacy components, state management, and API integrations into patterns that actually scale.
   

  

 This is a full\-time position based out of Kochi.
   

  

***Preferred Location***
 Qualified candidates should be based in or near Kochi and able to work from our Kochi office as part of a hybrid schedule.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Build features in Angular 21 using Signals, standalone components, and zoneless change detection
* Dig into older code, understand it, and refactor it into something maintainable
* Contribute to our Angular Material \-\> Zard UI migration
* Build reactive data flows with NgRx and RxJS
* Build components that look and work great on both mobile and desktop using TailwindCSS and Sass


***Education Requirement***
 Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Master of Computer Applications.
   

  

***Role and Responsibilities***
* Play a pivotal role in the team, working closely with Product \& UX teams, to single handedly own individual modules that are part of an enterprise suite of applications
* Lead the design and solution for refactoring complex legacy codebases
* Play an important role in optimization across solution/architecture/code
* Lead technical conversations with non\-engineering stakeholders
* Influence a positive team culture: raising the bar on quality, documentation, and shared ownership
* Define and optimize CI/CD pipelines and automation
* Design, development of scalable enterprise grade applications
* Scoping and breaking down large initiatives into iterative, shippable pieces
* Review code, share knowledge, and help shape how we build things going forward
* Strongly desirable \- Having exposure to AI tools to develop UI screens \& troubleshoot production issues


**Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* 7\-10 years in frontend/UI engineering
* Strong Angular 21 skills for: Signals, Signal Forms, standalone components, zoneless change detection
* NgRx and RxJS
* TailwindCSS and Sass, with a strong grasp of responsive design for mobile and desktop
* Play a pivotal role in the team, working closely with Product \& UX teams, to build products that are designed to meet the demands of scale
* Comfortable reading and refactoring complex legacy codebases
* Rich experience in optimization across solution/architecture/code
* Strongly desirable \- Having exposure to AI tools to develop UI screens \& troubleshoot production issues


**About Dodge Construction Network**
 Dodge Construction Network exists to deliver the comprehensive data and connections the construction industry needs to build thriving communities. Our legacy is deeply rooted in empowering our customers with transformative insights, igniting their journey towards unparalleled business expansion and success. We serve decision\-makers who seek reliable growth and who value relationships built on trust and quality. By combining our proprietary data with cutting\-edge software, we deliver to our customers the essential intelligence needed to excel within their respective landscapes. We propel the construction industry forward by transforming data into tangible guidance, driving unparalleled advancement.
   

  

 Dodge is the catalyst for modern construction.

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
* The role is for a consultant who can take up opportunities in marketing, sales, service and process transformation engagements.
* You will be responsible for executing tasks with increasing autonomy, applying sound judgment within defined parameters, and contributing to team outcomes. You are expected to demonstrate initiative, resolve routine issues independently, and support junior colleagues.
* You will anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.
* In line with EY commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer.

* Good to have prior experience in any of the platforms such as Salesforce, Dynamics 365, Oracle, SAP, PROS, etc
* Good to have vertical \& Industry Experience in Consumer Industries or Retail, eCommerce, Telecom, BFSI, Product organisations or CX Consulting services.


**What We Look For**
* 1\-5 years of experience of prior experience
* Completed or pursuing (in final year) Master’s degree program in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Sales or related field
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with attention to detail.
* Creative thinking and problem\-solving abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with CRM, process design, data analysis tools and platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, power\-bi, Salesforce, Adobe etc)
* Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks in a fast\-paced environment.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
